name: omp-plugin-duplicate-detector
description: Code clone and duplication detector plugin for oh-my-pi powered by jscpd

omp.name: duplicate-detector
omp.description: Detect duplicate and clone code blocks across your codebase powered by jscpd

minLines.description: Minimum duplicated lines (in the edited file) required to report a duplicate

minTokens.description: Minimum duplicated tokens required to report a duplicate

reminderMode.description: How the model is warned: steer (warning card + message at the next step) or in-band (additional context on the write/edit tool result). Use /duplicates off to disable.

ignorePatterns.description: Additional comma-separated gitignore-style patterns to skip (commas inside {braces} are kept)

ignoreTests.description: Skip test files, test directories, mocks, fixtures, and snapshots

maxIndexedFiles.description: Maximum number of files held in the duplicate index
